text:
Dana L.: Heads-up 6a8 Monarch Logistics renewal ~5.5 weeks. We just saw a ~64% drop in API usage after their ML lead left and a new internal privacy review paused production calls. Procurement mentioned an AtlasAI bench. Need quick triage.
Omar R.: Oof. Any error spikes or auth churn? Do we have route-level diffs? :eyes: 
Dana L.: Console quick clip:
```
30d active keys: 1,050 -> 380 (-64%)
Top endpoints: /predict (-68%), /bulk-embed (-50%)
Error rate: 0.5% (stable)
p95 lat: 330ms
```
Dana L.: Champion (Head of Analytics) supportive but pulled offline for privacy audit. New PM + legal running the review. Procurement asked for a short reliability note and a cost comparison vs AtlasAI.
Priya Nair: Proposed triage:
 Outreach: health call with champion + new PM + legal (owner: Dana)
 Competitive: 1-page compare vs AtlasAI (owner: Omar)
 Tech: scoped quant + batching perf run on their top prompts (owner: Ken)
 Enablement: 45m workshop focused on integration security & cost levers (owner: Priya)
Ken - CS Lead: I'll run a lightweight perf & quant experiment once they share 15-20 prompts and a small quality rubric. ETA 72h. Need sample prompts and any golden responses.
eng-bot: Ticket CS-9001 created: "Monarch Logistics - quant & perf bakeoff" assigned to Ken, due in 3 business days.
Omar R.: I'll build the AtlasAI snapshot: unit token pricing, latency p50/p95, embeddings parity notes, and migration friction (SDK + infra). ETA 48h. Will include suggested messaging.
Salesbot: Flagging for Sales: potential short concession might be needed if procurement accelerates to competitor. Please include ARR delta.
Priya Nair: Enablement checklist: integration security checklist, cost levers (batching/caching/quant), privacy-safe logging guidance, and a short rollback plan. Keep it tactical for legal + PM.
Dana L.: Action items recap:
- Request sample prompts + confirm health call participants (Dana)  due today EOD
- AtlasAI one-pager + migration notes (Omar)  due in 48h
- Quant/batching perf run & artifacts (Ken via CS-9001)  due in 3 business days
- Enablement workshop scheduling + deck (Priya)  schedule by EOD tomorrow
- Draft short renewal playbook + optional concession ask (Dana + Sales)  draft in 72h
Ken - CS Lead: If quant + batching shows ~30% cost down with <5% quality delta on their rubric, that's our primary retention lever. I'll post diffs in CS-9001.
Omar R.: I'll add a short appendix on data residency and logging differences for legal to review.
Dana L.: Scheduling health call for tomorrow 11am PT and including champion, new PM, and legal. CCing Sales + RevOps. CC me on invite.
Priya Nair: I'll prepare a 20-min section in the workshop specifically for legal: what we log, retention, and redaction options.
Dana L.: Thanks team. Paste any procurement timelines or AtlasAI bench details here. We'll reconvene after the health call and update last_message_ts. :handshake:
